text: Pricing call done. Priya objected to monthly billing outright — reads as non-committal to her CFO. Resolved: annual billing with 8% discount. She said quote me: don't bring monthly back to the table.
Copy that — pricing is settled, annual + 8%. Nobody re-opens this. If finance asks, the answer is the August proposal, not a new conversation.
Proposal goes out Saturday. $86k ARR, 240 seats. Numbers match what I told her on the call to the dollar.
